resolved_conflicts.explanation: Encyclopedia of Arkansas gives forty-six standing in 2023; Preserve Arkansas gives about 40. Story reports both without choosing one.

notes_for_editor: Only tower-specific sources are the NHLR entry and an OpenStreetMap node. Two web searches and the Forest Lookouts index stub found nothing more about this tower. The brief's access 'unknown' can now read private (appears), per the Register. The brief's elevation_m 81.7 matches 268 ft, which is ground elevation, not tower height. Register says the tower is still standing, so status is supported. Survivor counts disagree (46 vs about 40); both reported in the story.
